entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Me ne ngañia, ha Zama, na wua onga vele ma ná meyem wua ya kang wua. Me ne ngañia eyondji nfá kaa ngu djam ya en ngu djue, ateiñ dam ya acum due. Zama nfe ases alorané wua, eñi avoro eyong otere abé ya naa wua fe wuaning ya en ngu djue.
